67:13.text: And conceal your speech or publicize it; indeed, He is Knowing of that within the breasts.

67:14.text: Does He who created not know,
while He is the Subtle, the Aware?

67:15.text: It is He who made the earth tame
for you - so walk among its slopes and eat of His provision - and to Him is the resurrection.

67:16.text: Do you feel secure that He who is above
would not cause the earth to swallow you and suddenly it would sway?

67:17.text: Or do you feel secure that He who is above would not send against you a storm of stones? Then you would know how

67:18.text: And already had those before them denied, and how

67:19.text: Do they not see the birds above them with wings outspread and
except the Most Merciful. Indeed He is, of all things, Seeing.

67:20.text: Or who is it that could be an army for you to aid you other than the Most Merciful? The disbelievers are not but in delusion.

67:21.text: Or who is it that could provide for you if He withheld His provision? But they have persisted in insolence and aversion.

67:22.text: Then is one who walks fallen on his face better guided or one who walks erect on a straight path?

67:23.text: Say, "It is He who has produced you and made for you hearing and vision and hearts

67:24.text: Say, "It is He who has multiplied you throughout the earth, and to Him you will be gathered."

67:25.text: And they say, "When is this promise, if you should be truthful?"

67:26.text: Say, "The knowledge is only with Allāh, and I am only a clear warner."
